core: ER protein export and quality control
qualifier: COPII cargo exit and ERAD retrotranslocation
name: COPII-mediated ER export and ER protein quality control
rationale: Members cover ER exit-site cargo loading, COPII vesicle targeting to Golgi, ER retention and ERQC/ERAD retrotranslocation, unlike confusables centred on SRP-dependent ER targeting/folding or COPI retrograde traffic.

qualifier: GPCR agonists (ADP, thrombin, thromboxane, prostacyclin) via Rho and Rap1
name: Platelet activation by GPCR agonists via Rho and Rap1
rationale: All members concern platelet activation through P2Y, PAR, TP and IP receptors coupling to G12/13-Rho and Rap1, whereas confusables emphasise GPVI/collagen adhesion, degranulation, coagulation or integrin-MAPK linkage.

qualifier: pyrophosphate and diadenosine polyphosphate hydrolysis
name: Ribonucleotide phosphorylation and pyrophosphate bond hydrolysis
rationale: Members interconvert nucleoside mono-, di- and triphosphates (ADP, GDP, GTP) and hydrolyse pyrophosphate and Ap4A, distinct from deoxynucleotide salvage, creatine/mitochondrial ADP-ATP transport and inositol pyrophosphate confusables.

qualifier: negative feedback and oncogenic RAS/RAF/MEK mutants
name: RAS-MAPK cascade regulation, feedback and oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members span RAS GEF/GAP control, RAF and MEK/ERK activation, ERK inactivation and feedback, and BRAF/RAF1/MAP2K/RAS mutant signalling, whereas confusables are upstream RTK (FGFR/ERBB/MET), PI3K-AKT or RTK drug-resistance pathways.

qualifier: vasopressin and aquaporins
name: Vasopressin and aquaporin-mediated water homeostasis
rationale: All members concern vasopressin signalling, its receptors and defects, aquaporin water transport and renal water retention, unlike confusables on renin-angiotensin, sodium/osmotic handling or aquaglyceroporin glycerol/urea transport.

qualifier: mesenchymal integrin and focal adhesion programme
name: Mesenchymal integrin-matrix adhesion, focal adhesion assembly and migration
rationale: Members describe fibroblast/mesenchymal integrin-ECM adhesion, fibronectin matrix, focal adhesion and stress fibre assembly and cell migration, unlike confusables on structural ECM, Rho effector kinases or adhesion disassembly/invadopodia.

qualifier: heme biosynthesis and metal detoxification
name: Transition metal ion homeostasis, heme biosynthesis and detoxification
rationale: Members handle iron, zinc, copper, manganese and cadmium transport, metallothionein detoxification and heme synthesis/scavenging, distinct from ROS/NADPH redox, oxidative phosphorylation and erythrocyte gas/ammonium transport confusables.

core: Monocarboxylate and lipid nutrient membrane transport
qualifier: lactate, carnitine and fatty acid transporters and their deficiencies
name: Lactate, carnitine and fatty acid transporters and deficiencies
rationale: Members concern SLC16/basigin lactate transport, carnitine and fatty acid uptake and their inherited defects, unlike confusables on pyruvate/creatine, organic anion/cation transport or the mitochondrial carnitine shuttle.

qualifier: mannose and dolichol-phosphate-mannose supply
name: Congenital glycosylation disorders of mannose and dolichol-phosphate-mannose supply
rationale: Members are CDGs of MPI, PMM2, PGM1, DOLK and DPM1-3 plus dolichyl-phosphate mannose synthesis, unlike confusables covering other CDG steps or normal GDP-mannose biosynthesis.

qualifier: Hox clusters, somitogenesis and neural crest derivatives
name: Hox and neural crest-driven axial and craniofacial patterning
rationale: Members cover Hox clusters, hindbrain and somite segmentation, neural crest and craniofacial, ear, limb and pharyngeal organ morphogenesis, unlike confusables centred on joints, forebrain or axial mesoderm/neural tube patterning.

qualifier: BH3-only activation through apoptosome caspase activation
name: Mitochondrial apoptosis from BH3-only activation to apoptosome caspase activation
rationale: Members run from BID/BIM/BAD/BMF activation and BAX/BAK oligomerization to apoptotic factor release, apoptosome and SMAC-IAP caspase activation, whereas confusables focus on MOMP regulation or NOXA/PUMA-BCL2 inactivation.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I with nucleolar chromatin control
name: Nucleolar rRNA gene transcription and its chromatin control
rationale: Members cover Pol I initiation to termination, 5S rRNA synthesis, early rRNA cleavage, MYC targets and NoRC/B-WICH/SIRT1 chromatin regulation of rDNA, unlike confusables on Pol III/translation, Pol II elongation or rRNA processing.

qualifier: contractile force, heart rate and hypertrophic adaptation
name: Positive regulation of cardiac contractility and hypertrophic adaptation
rationale: Members regulate heart contraction force, rate and relaxation plus stress hypertrophy and cardiac adaptation, distinct from calcineurin/proliferation-regeneration and calcium-handling confusables.

qualifier: voltage-gated and inward-rectifier channels
name: Voltage-gated and inward-rectifier potassium channels in cardiac action potential
rationale: Members are Kv and Kir channels, delayed rectifier regulation and phase 1/phase 4 of the cardiac action potential, unlike confusables on K2P/KATP/BK channels, depolarisation/conduction or plateau-repolarisation phases.

qualifier: COPII and COPI coats with vesicle tethering
name: COPII and COPI vesicle traffic between ER and Golgi
rationale: Members combine COPII cargo loading and ER-to-Golgi targeting with COPI budding and retrograde traffic plus Golgi tethering, unlike confusables on ER quality control/SRP targeting or intra-Golgi/anterograde COPI traffic.

core: TGF-beta and activin SMAD2/3 signalling regulation
qualifier: betaglycan (TGFBR3) and follistatin modulation
name: TGF-beta and activin signalling tuned by betaglycan and follistatin
rationale: Members regulate TGF-beta/activin-SMAD2/3 signalling via TGFBR3 co-receptor, follistatin antagonism and SMAD downregulation, unlike confusables on cancer receptor/SMAD mutants, BMP signalling or RUNX3.

qualifier: altered GPIb, collagen binding and ADAMTS13 cleavage
name: Von Willebrand factor variant defects in binding and ADAMTS13 cleavage
rationale: All members are VWF or GP1BA variants altering VWF-collagen or GPIb binding or ADAMTS13 cleavage, unlike basement membrane, contact activation, fibrinolysis or coagulation cascade confusables.

qualifier: DUB control of ubiquitin chains and NF-kappaB activity
name: Deubiquitinase control of ubiquitin chains and NF-kappaB activity
rationale: Members include USP, OTU and metalloprotease DUBs, K11/K48/K63 deubiquitination and regulation of NF-kappaB/transcription factor activity, unlike confusables on proteasome/neddylation, TNFR1 linear ubiquitination or atypical chain synthesis.

qualifier: tubular network shaping and organelle contact tethering
name: ER tubular network shaping and organelle membrane contact tethering
rationale: Members cover ER tubule formation, membrane bending and fusion, ER-mitochondria/plasma membrane tethering and Miro GTPase cycles, unlike confusables on lipid transfer, phosphoinositide synthesis or kinesin-based organelle transport.

qualifier: pneumocyte differentiation
name: Alveolar saccule development and pneumocyte differentiation
rationale: All three members concern lung saccule formation and type I/II pneumocyte differentiation, unlike confusables on surfactant metabolism or branching morphogenesis.

qualifier: post-translational p53 control
name: DNA damage-induced G2 checkpoint and post-translational p53 control
rationale: Members cover G2 DNA damage checkpoint signalling, Cdc25A degradation, GTSE1/MASTL recovery and p53 phosphorylation/degradation, unlike confusables on p53 target transcription, p14ARF defects or unperturbed G2/M transition.

core: Germline and early embryo gene regulation
qualifier: piRNA silencing, gametogenesis and maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Germline piRNA silencing, gametogenesis and maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members span piRNA biogenesis and transposon silencing, spermatogenesis, oocyte and germ cell specification, and zygotic genome activation, unlike confusables on imprinting/X-inactivation or maternal mRNA deadenylation and M-decay.

qualifier: interferon-stimulated antiviral effectors
name: Type I interferon-stimulated antiviral effector response
rationale: Members are IFN-alpha response signatures and ISG effectors (ISG15, OAS, PKR) with feedback regulation, distinct from confusables on nucleic acid sensing, TLR/RIG-I/cGAS signalling and IFN production.

qualifier: UPR, integrated stress response, NRF2 and FOXO
name: UPR, integrated stress response and NRF2/FOXO stress transcription
rationale: Members cover ATF6/IRE1/PERK UPR, HRI/GCN2 translational stress control, UPRmt, and NRF2 and AKT-FOXO stress transcription, unlike confusables on heat shock/chaperonins, ER translocation/ERAD or p53/mTORC1 metabolism.

qualifier: SRP-dependent and tail-anchored insertion
name: SRP-dependent and tail-anchored protein targeting to the ER
rationale: Members concern co- and post-translational ER targeting, signal recognition, translocation and tail-anchored/stop-transfer membrane insertion, unlike confusables on COPII/COPI export, ERQC and ERAD.
